notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked; simulated R0, model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware or simulator run and no MHS-Device level claimed). All three card entry symbols were confirmed in the clone (Tableware.py:17, Microwave.py:19 and Drawer.py:19); the package serves the first, WorldComposer-Tableware-v0, registered with TablewareEnv at Task01_Tableware/__init__.py:3-9. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD mock path: mock_strategy.preferred is upstream-sim, but the tasks need Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, a CUDA GPU and the external WorldComposer_Assets dataset (README.md:45-54 and :74-86), the task config imports Isaac Lab and the robot USD asset config (Tableware_cfg.py:4-12), and package code never imports or runs the clone; the fake is therefore the package's own pure Python interface stand-in (fake.py), the upstream simulator path was not run, and only the fake backend is declared. The fake reproduces the contract, not the physics: action_space 6 and observation_space 6 from Tableware_cfg.py:20-21, the two observation keys action and observation.state with six joint positions from Tableware.py:103-113, the zero reward from Tableware.py:133-135, and the time-out that marks both terminated and truncated from Tableware.py:137-139. The default joint positions are the SO101 values of Tableware_cfg.py:31-38. The action and observation space objects are created by the external DirectRLEnv and were not inspected, so the fake exposes unbounded six-value Boxes and neither rejects nor clamps a finite action; no action limit is invented and G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE awards CL2 instead of CL3. The fake time limit of 7200 steps is a placeholder derived from episode_length_s 60 and dt 1/120 s with decimation 1 (Tableware_cfg.py:17-18 and :25); the rule that applies it lives in the external DirectRLEnv. NOT COVERED: the optional top and wrist RGB/depth camera arrays (960 x 720 per camera, Tableware_cfg.py:42-79; the keys are added only when task_config.teleop.enable_cameras is true, Tableware.py:115-129), the reset-time object/scale/position/texture/lighting randomization (Tableware.py:157 onwards), the 0.035 m XY success check (success_checker.py:97-113), and all Isaac Sim physics, contacts, actuators, sensors, noise and rendering. Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the next reset); G7.MAYBE_ABSENT x5 for action_space, observation_space, reset, step and close, which are the Gymnasium interface inherited from the external DirectRLEnv base; the four G8.NO_UNIT warnings for the bridge-derived integer and action inputs; and G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE because no finite action bound can be sourced. There are no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Recon notes: the clone has no LICENSE file at its root or under source/WorldComposer, while setup.py:32 declares Apache-2.0; the card's license_spdx NOASSERTION and license_class unknown are kept in driver.lock.json because G2 pins the card, and no human review or licence conclusion is claimed. The README installs Python 3.11 with torch 2.7.0, lerobot 0.4.1 and isaacsim[all,extscache] and downloads the external Assets/ dataset (README.md:45-54 and :74-86); none of this was installed or run, and the gate and fake need none of it (setup.py:34 requires Python 3.10+). check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
